label: Weddings
seoTitle: Live Wedding Music in Los Angeles | Sean Carney
seoDescription: Ceremony, cocktail hour and reception music from Sean Carney, solo or with his band The Scene. Fifteen years of weddings across Los Angeles and abroad.
headline: Ceremony to last dance
intro: One SCE team for your whole celebration: acoustic ceremony music, a duo or jazz ensemble over cocktails, then a full-band reception with sound and lighting. A custom song, written and recorded by Sean, makes the story yours.
imageAlt: Sean Carney performing at an evening wedding beneath string lights

items.title: Ceremony
items.body: Acoustic arrangements for the processional, the vows and the recessional, including a custom aisle song.

items.title: Cocktail hour
items.body: Sinatra and modern standards while guests find their drinks and each other.

items.title: Dinner
items.body: Warm, conversational sets that let the room breathe.

items.title: First dance
items.body: Your song, arranged for the moment. Many couples ask for an acoustic version of a track they love.

items.title: Reception
items.body: The Scene take the floor, and keep it full.

blocks.title: Your story, set to music
blocks.body: SCE’s full-service wedding experience brings the ceremony, cocktail hour, reception band, sound and lighting together with an original song written and recorded for the couple. Sean plans the details and investment with you in your consultation.

blocks.alt: Sean Carney performing acoustic guitar in a garden at a wedding
blocks.caption: An acoustic set in the garden, before the evening begins.

blocks.title: Most requested
blocks.note: Frank Sinatra and modern standards for the cocktail hour. Full set lists, and your own requests, on request.
solo: Can't Help Falling in Love, Elvis Presley

blocks.title: For your planner
items: Ceremony sound can run separately from the reception
Timeline built with your planner and venue

items.title: Share the date
items.body: A short inquiry with the date, the place and a few details, or a call if you would rather talk.

items.title: A personal reply
items.body: Sean replies within one business day with availability and a few questions about the day.

items.title: A proposal for your day
items.body: Built around the date, the room, the formats and the hours of music.

items.title: Your date is held
items.body: Once the agreement is signed. Then the timeline, the songs and the sound are planned with you and your planner.

label: Corporate and brand
seoTitle: Corporate Event and Brand Activation Music | Sean Carney
seoDescription: Live music for corporate events, launches and brand activations from an artist heard on the Olympics, the NFL Playoffs and national campaigns.
headline: For companies that care how the room feels
intro: An artist whose songs have run in national campaigns and on network sports, who arrives briefed, on time and fluent in run-of-show.
imageAlt: Sean Carney playing acoustic guitar on a corporate event stage with LED screens

blocks.title: Booked by
blocks.story: His music has scored the 2024 Paris Olympics, the 2025 NFL Playoffs and campaigns for Hyundai and WeightWatchers. For a launch or activation, that is a story your audience already knows how to tell.

blocks.title: Where he fits in the program

items.title: Conferences and expos
items.body: Arrival sets, keynote walk-ons and an evening program that keeps attendees in the room.

items.title: Launches and activations
items.body: Original or custom song options on request, with an artist your guests can look up afterward.

items.title: Holiday parties and incentives
items.body: From a solo acoustic reception to a full band on the dance floor.

items.v: Stage plot, tech rider and certificate of insurance on request
Works directly with agencies, DMCs and AV
Built to your run-of-show, to the minute

label: Private and estate
seoTitle: Private Party and Estate Event Musician | Sean Carney
seoDescription: Discreet, volume-aware live music for private estates, milestone celebrations and intimate dinners across Los Angeles, Malibu, Montecito and beyond.
headline: Private rooms, handled privately
intro: Milestone birthdays, anniversaries and dinners at home. Sean reads a room quickly and keeps the volume where conversation lives.
imageAlt: Sean Carney laughing in a suit and hat, holding an acoustic guitar outdoors

blocks.title: Discretion is the default.
blocks.body: Nothing is photographed, posted or mentioned without your permission. NDAs are welcome, and house managers and security teams are looped in from the first call.

items.title: Dinners and salons
items.body: Solo acoustic sets sized for a living room or a garden table.

items.title: Milestones
items.body: Birthdays and anniversaries with the songs that belong to the people in the room.

items.title: After dinner
items.body: When the night turns, the band can turn with it.

seoTitle: Charity Gala Entertainment in Los Angeles | Sean Carney

imageAlt: Sean Carney in a black suit with an acoustic guitar against the hills

items.title: Reception
items.body: Acoustic sets that make the silent auction feel like a party.

items.title: Featured performance
items.body: A short, high-impact set timed to the room.

items.title: Paddle raise
items.body: An anthem cue to lift the moment, if you want one.

items.title: After-party
items.body: The full band for the guests who stay.

label: Destination
seoTitle: Destination Wedding and Event Musician | Sean Carney
seoDescription: Sean Carney has performed in more than 50 countries and travels for destination weddings, retreats and private events worldwide.
headline: Wherever the vows are
intro: For destination weddings, retreats and offsites, Sean travels light as a soloist or brings The Scene, and works through logistics early with your team.
imageAlt: Sean Carney with a guitar on the beach at sunset

items.title: Share the date and place
items.body: Availability and a travel-inclusive proposal come back together.

items.title: Plan logistics early
items.body: Flights, backline and timings are set with your planner well ahead.

items.title: Arrive ready
items.body: Sound check on site, then the same ceremony-to-reception coverage as at home.
